summary: Reproduced both reported NIXL staging worker defects on the prepared main checkout: an asynchronous transfer read a shared staging buffer after the next destination overwrote it, and a deferred destination caused completed destinations to be replayed while submitted handles remained live. The fix waits for each staged transfer before reusing its worker-local source buffer, drains all submitted handles before a deferred chunk is dequeued again, and records completed destination session identities on the queued chunk so retries process only unfinished destinations.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before run on base behavior: all three regressions failed, showing A read B's staged source, A was replayed after B deferred, and unfinished mixed-memory handles survived into the next dequeue. Raw output: reports/j-c2f5542ddd89/raw/failing-before.txt

Passing-after run: the three worker-level regressions passed, covering source-buffer lifetime, retry deduplication, and draining mixed VRAM/DRAM/state/aux handles before retry. Raw output: reports/j-c2f5542ddd89/raw/passing-after-focused.txt
103 related NIXL/disaggregation tests passed, with 14 subtests passed. Raw output: reports/j-c2f5542ddd89/raw/passing-after-suite.txt
Patch whitespace validation passed. Ruff and Black were not installed in the prepared interpreter, so those separate module invocations could not run.

gpu_execution.evidence: The assigned single gfx950 GPU was detected as AMD Instinct MI350X with ROCm 7.2 and NIXL importable (reports/j-c2f5542ddd89/raw/environment.txt), but the reported fanout requires distinct prefill/decode endpoints and heterogeneous TP. The regression therefore exercised the actual worker and retry logic with asynchronous transfer/GPU operations simulated; no real GPU transfer was claimed.

remaining_limitations: No multi-process or multi-node NIXL transfer was run; the assigned environment exposes only one GPU.
No model weights were loaded, so the production text corruption symptom and semantic model accuracy were not reproduced.
The tests deterministically validate worker scheduling, shared-source lifetime, completion polling, and destination retry state, but simulate NIXL completion and GPU gathers.
Ruff and Black are absent from the prepared Python environment; git diff --check and the focused Python test suites were used instead.
No native source changed and no native rebuild was applicable.
